mapper.select: SELECT id, leave_code, employee_id, employee_name, leave_type, start_date, end_date, leave_days, reason, attachment_url, approval_id, approval_status, approver_id, approver_name, approval_time, approval_remark, tenant_id, provider_trace_id, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM pmis_leave WHERE deleted = 0 AND leave_code = #{leaveCode} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, leave_code, employee_id, employee_name, leave_type, start_date, end_date, leave_days, reason, attachment_url, approval_id, approval_status, approver_id, approver_name, approval_time, approval_remark, tenant_id, provider_trace_id, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM pmis_leave WHERE deleted = 0 AND employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY start_date DESC

SELECT id, leave_code, employee_id, employee_name, leave_type, start_date, end_date, leave_days, reason, attachment_url, approval_id, approval_status, approver_id, approver_name, approval_time, approval_remark, tenant_id, provider_trace_id, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM pmis_leave WHERE deleted = 0 AND approval_status = #{approvalStatus} ORDER BY start_date DESC

SELECT id, leave_code, employee_id, employee_name, leave_type, start_date, end_date, leave_days, reason, attachment_url, approval_id, approval_status, approver_id, approver_name, approval_time, approval_remark, tenant_id, provider_trace_id, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM pmis_leave WHERE deleted = 0 AND approval_status = 'APPROVED' AND employee_id = #{employeeId} AND start_date <= #{endDate} AND end_date >= #{startDate} ORDER BY start_date DESC
